name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 4 – Am 33
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 4a. Strongly condemns and is deeply concerned by the ongoing genocide being committed by the Israeli authorities in the Gaza Strip; denounces the atrocities, war crimes and serious violations of international human rights law and international humanitarian law committed by the Israeli authorities in Gaza, the West Bank, Lebanon and Syria; condemns, in the strongest possible terms, the Israeli indiscriminate attacks with air strikes and the use of chemical weapons against civilians, the forced expulsion of populations, the use of sexual violence and torture, the attacks on hospitals, schools and basic infrastructure and the denial of humanitarian aid access; underlines that these attacks are war crimes and a violation of the Geneva Conventions; condemns Israel’s policy of collective punishment against the people of Gaza, which is contrary to international humanitarian law and must be stopped; highlights the catastrophic humanitarian situation and calls for the risk of mass starvation, the worsening of health conditions and the outbreak of a health epidemic in Gaza to be addressed; calls for an immediate and permanent ceasefire in Gaza;
